observation.command:
mkdir -p /opt/mapserver/run /opt/mapserver/ms4w/tmp/ms_tmp
cd /opt/mapserver
# Copy config files to runtime dir
cp mapserver.map common.txt layers.txt internal.map run/
cd run
# Substitute ${VAR} placeholders with concrete configuration values (guide: "Variablen durch Konfigurationswerte ersetzen")
sed -i \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_WMS_MAXWIDTH}|4096|g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_MAPSERVER_URL_PUBLIC}|http://127.0.0.1:8090|g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_MAPSERVER_URL_INTERNAL}|http://127.0.0.1:8090|g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_ACCESSCONSTRAINTS}||g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_FEES}||g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_METADATA_URL}|http://127.0.0.1:8080|g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_CONTACT_ADDRESS_ADMINAREA}||g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_CONTACT_ADDRESS_CITY}||g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_CONTACT_ADDRESS_COUNTRY}||g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_CONTACT_ADDRESS_DELIVERYPOINT}||g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_CONTACT_ADDRESS_POSTALCODE}||g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_CONTACT_MAIL}|info@example.org|g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_CONTACT_NAME}|xPlanBox Admin|g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_CONTACT_PHONE}|+49-000-000000|g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_CONTACT_POSITIONNAME}|Administrator|g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_NAME}|xPlanBox|g' \
 -e 's|${XPLAN_SERVICES_PROVIDER_ONLINERESOURCE}|http://127.0.0.1:8090|g' \
 *.map *.txt
echo "=== remaining \${} vars ==="; grep -ohE '\$\{[A-Za-z_0-9]+\}' *.map *.txt | sort -u | head; echo "(empty = all substituted)"
